reason: Every page the Buildpad CLI scaffolds is under `app/[lang]/` since CLI 2.3: the scope picker page is `app/[lang]/select-scope/page.tsx`. The scope picker and `ScopeGuard` samples navigate with the CLI's `useLocaleRouter`, not `useRouter` from `next/navigation`.

Every page the Buildpad CLI scaffolds is under `app/[lang]/` since CLI 2.3: the scope picker page is `app/[lang]/select-scope/page.tsx`, the root layout `app/[lang]/layout.tsx`, and `ScopeProvider` is shown in the authenticated layout, never the root layout (Bug 22). The picker sample uses `useLocaleRouter` and sits in `app/[lang]/(authenticated)/select-scope/page.tsx`, where `useDaaSContext` has its provider; the missing-scope redirect moves from a root-layout `redirect('/select-scope')`, which loops, to the CLI's middleware; `useScopeErrorHandler` uses `useLocaleRouter`.
